uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2105-5434-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5434-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5434-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

643-3000-3510-4288.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-3000-3510-4288.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

728-2466-3249-4242.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

772-3899-6553.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-5931.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6139.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Caves of Chaos Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

3249-5147-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
3249-5147-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

1636-3007-5371-7629.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1636-3007-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Toymaker.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-3007-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

891-2730-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2191-4416-5934.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to deal damage to a creature.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
2191-4416-5934.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Vindicator.
Activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting a creature.
Attempt to deal damage to the targeted creature. The damage will then be increased due to The Rollercrusher Ride, then redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator, which is then redirected back to the creature that was originally targeted.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting the creature. 
Repeat step 4 until all damage will be redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Weftstalker Ardent with "Pirate" chosen

4508-6847-7040.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4508-6847-7040.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Psychic Paper, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

141-2921-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

4153-5223-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-5223-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control that does not have summoning sickness

515-1636-2348.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat

1734-2292-3817.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1395-2478-4195-4574.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1636-1921-1977.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Tivit from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Tivit token enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trgger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Tivit trigger, choosing to vote for bribery twice and create two Treasure tokens, and then creating an additional Clue or Treasure per opponent based on their votes.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Tivit token and causing you to mill two cards.
Put either Tivit token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-1921-1977.notes: This combo will result in infinite Clue tokens, but also can result in infinite Treasure tokens based off your opponents' choices. If your opponents give you infinite Treasures, you can then choose to create Clue tokens with your votes and get infinite of both. These Treasures can also be used to activate Tawnos's second ability repeatedly with creature cards. However, it is far more likely your opponents will give you infinite Clue tokens.

2981-5362-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
2981-5362-5365.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
2981-5362-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2533-3388-3967-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
Repeat.

3055-3175-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2061-4125-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2061-4125-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

198-3750-5793.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
198-3750-5793.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2438-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2438-5776-5777.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2060-3129-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

2440-3480-3952-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Phoenix.
2440-3480-3952-4050.description:
Activate Purphoros by paying {2}{R}, putting Firestorm Phoenix onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Firestorm Phoenix enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Firestorm Phoenix, adding {R}.
Firestorm Phoenix is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard.
Repeat.
If there are at least two other Phoenixs on the battlefield, this combo will produce infinite colorless mana.

147-2034-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Ascend from Avernus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ascend from Avernus, returning all creature and planeswalker cards with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

228-3558-3701-4763.description:
Equip Skullclamp to Crookshank Kobolds for {0}.
Crookshank Kobolds dies.
Skullclamp triggers, drawing you 2 cards.
Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds.
Repeat.

1323-3990-3995.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can produce {U}.
1323-3990-3995.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Incubation Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 6.
